test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Four friends R, S, T and U are sitting at the exact centre of the sides of a rectangular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). R is sitting to the immediate right of S. T is sitting to the immediate left of U.

Which of the following pairs of friends is sitting opposite to each other?
solution:
Given: Four friends R, S, T and U.

1) R is sitting to the immediate right of S.

2) T is sitting to the immediate left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dcaddaf8374fb26a2203db9dc8da526b371ef13680a15d2d5a38f8c717ed250.png] 

Here, from the arrangement the pair 'R - U' is sitting opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
